issues.description: The problem statement (and task text) requires the attribute 'rides' in ExcellenceLand to be private and of type List<Ride>, but the solution implementation declares 'rides' as public. This visibility mismatch contradicts the specification and would confuse students about the expected encapsulation (and may cause tests that assert privacy to fail).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the 'rides' attribute private in ExcellenceLand (private List<Ride> rides;) and keep or add a public getter getRides(). Update the constructor to assign to the private field. Ensure the template and solution both declare the field as private to match the problem specification.
